title: Current-v20 Doom Walker / SuperRunningBoss recovery for generic Monster scans
trigger: User-reported level-200 Doom Walker visible on the world map but absent from the Monster scan/filter list.

recoveredContract.uiClassification: UIDoomsdayBossItem.Refresh uses WorldMonsterSpecialType.SuperRunningBoss for these event bosses

implementation.requestBehavior: Issue the same read-only ActivityDoomsdayMainInfo request once at the start of a generic whole-world Monster probe and allow a bounded 0.75-second settle.
implementation.mergeBehavior: Merge only manager rows whose current Monster template special equals SuperRunningBoss; derive coordinates from point_id, template config/name/level from MonsterTemplateManager, retain exact monster_uid string identity, and deduplicate against already-materialized WorldMarch rows by exact UUID.
failClosed: Missing SuperRunningBoss enum fails the Monster probe.
Invalid point_id fails the Monster probe.
Incomplete template identity fails the Monster probe.
Host requires doomsdayBossCount to equal normalized manager-provenance rows for generic Monster scans and to be zero for Zombie Boss scans.

checks: UIDoomsday.OnCreate performs a one-argument read-only SendMessage
manager normalizes server_boss/alliance_boss identity and position fields
UIDoomsdayBossItem.Refresh classifies the row as SuperRunningBoss

deterministicAcceptance.positiveFixture: A synthetic current-v20 manager-provenance SuperRunningBoss row is published as kind=monster with special/configSpecial=32 and is excluded from kind=zombie_boss.

earlierCurrentV20ReadOnlyDoomInfoProbe.interpretation: No active Doomsday/SuperRunningBoss population was available in the tested server session.

limits: A positive live Doom Walker row could not be proven on 2026-09-21 because the Doomsday/SuperRunningBoss event population was inactive/empty on server 2212 during the proof window.
The structural source contract and positive normalization path are source-backed and deterministic-tested, but LIVE-PROVEN positive-row status remains pending until the event is active.
The user-visible localized English string 'Doom Walker' is not hard-coded as the classifier; classification uses the game's SuperRunningBoss enum/template contract.
